verdict.rationale: The API has an edit_body find/replace endpoint that docs pitch as ideal for AI agents renaming a product across many articles, plus a list-all-posts endpoint. But edit_body is scoped to a single article ID, so multi-item changes appear to need client-side looping rather than a native bulk operation. Missing for 10: a dedicated batch/bulk endpoint, bulk actions on posts/feedback/conversations, documented bulk limits or rate handling, and hands-on corroboration.
